ask: Why is it on the path?
cards: The oldest of the seven wonders and the only one still standing.
Two thousand years of walls against the steppe, joined into one idea.
A caravan city carved into rose-red rock at the crossroads of incense routes.
Justinian's dome, church then mosque then museum then mosque, fifteen centuries at the centre of two faiths.
The largest religious monument on earth, the Khmer state in stone.
The last palace of al-Andalus, beauty built on a falling frontier.
An Inca royal estate the conquest never found.
The Mughal empire's wealth and craft condensed into one tomb.
